name: tumbleweed-scientific
description: Tumbleweed Scientific's reviewed plugins, skills and connectors for life-science research.

plugins.name: tumbleweed-research
plugins.description: Built-in research skills of the research agent.

plugins.name: bifrost-bio-mcp
plugins.description: 23 Biomedical & Scientific MCP servers unified via Tumbleweed Scientific's Bifrost AI Gateway (literature, genomics, chemistry, structures, clinical, expression).

bio-pubmed.title: PubMed & Europe PMC
bio-pubmed.description: Search PubMed, PMC full text, and Europe PMC biomedical literature and citations.

bio-chembl.title: ChEMBL
bio-chembl.description: Query ChEMBL bioactive molecules, drug targets, bioactivity assays, and mechanisms.

bio-cellguide.title: CELLxGENE CellGuide
bio-cellguide.description: Explore canonical cell types, marker genes, and single-cell reference ontologies in CELLxGENE.

bio-clinical-genomics.title: Clinical Genomics
bio-clinical-genomics.description: Query ClinGen gene-disease validity, CIViC somatic cancer variants, and Open Targets evidence.

bio-clinical-trials.title: ClinicalTrials.gov
bio-clinical-trials.description: Search registered clinical studies, eligibility criteria, endpoints, and trial status.

bio-biorxiv.title: bioRxiv & medRxiv
bio-biorxiv.description: Search and retrieve life-science and medical preprints from bioRxiv and medRxiv.

bio-variants.title: Human Variants
bio-variants.description: Look up population allele frequencies, CADD deleteriousness, ClinVar classifications, and dbSNP rsIDs.

bio-drug-regulatory.title: FDA Drug Regulatory
bio-drug-regulatory.description: Query openFDA drug approvals, prescribing labels, adverse events, and recalls.

bio-zinc.title: ZINC22
bio-zinc.description: Search ZINC22 purchasable screening compounds, conformers, and vendor catalogs.

bio-genes-ontologies.title: Genes & Ontologies
bio-genes-ontologies.description: Resolve gene annotations, GO terms, OLS ontologies, UniProt entries, and Reactome pathways.

bio-rna.title: RNA Families (Rfam)
bio-rna.description: Query Rfam non-coding RNA families, covariance models, secondary structures, and alignments.

bio-cancer-models.title: Cancer Models
bio-cancer-models.description: Explore DepMap CRISPR/RNAi dependencies, drug sensitivities, and cBioPortal cancer genomics cohorts.

bio-chemistry.title: Small-Molecule Chemistry
bio-chemistry.description: Query PubChem compounds, ChEBI chemical entities, Rhea biochemical reactions, and BindingDB affinities.

bio-structures-interactions.title: Structures & Interactions
bio-structures-interactions.description: Retrieve experimental and predicted 3D structures from PDB, AlphaFold DB, and EMDB plus IntAct and Complex Portal complexes.

bio-literature.title: Scholarly Literature
bio-literature.description: Search OpenAlex scholarly works, citation graphs, authors, and arXiv preprints.

bio-protein-annotation.title: Protein Annotation
bio-protein-annotation.description: Query InterPro/Pfam protein domains, Human Protein Atlas expression, and STRING interaction networks.

bio-research-resources.title: Research Resources
bio-research-resources.description: Search federal research funding opportunities on Grants.gov and validated antibodies in the Antibody Registry.

bio-human-genetics.title: Human Genetics
bio-human-genetics.description: Explore GWAS Catalog associations, eQTL Catalogue summary statistics, and PheWeb phenome-wide associations.

bio-expression.title: Gene & Tissue Expression
bio-expression.description: Query GTEx multi-tissue RNA expression and eQTLs alongside PanglaoDB single-cell marker expression.

bio-omics-archives.title: Omics Archives
bio-omics-archives.description: Search public multi-omics repositories across NCBI GEO, ArrayExpress, PRIDE proteomics, MetaboLights, and MGnify.

bio-biomart.title: Ensembl BioMart
bio-biomart.description: Run cross-species gene, transcript, homolog, and identifier batch queries through Ensembl BioMart.

bio-genomes.title: Genomes (Ensembl & UCSC)
bio-genomes.description: Fetch reference genome sequences, gene models, VEP consequences, and UCSC Genome Browser tracks.

bio-regulation.title: Gene Regulation
bio-regulation.description: Query ENCODE SCREEN cis-regulatory elements, JASPAR transcription factor motifs, and UniBind TFBS datasets.

plugins.name: bio-research
plugins.description: Connect to third-party life-sciences partner services (BioRender, Consensus, Synapse, Wiley Scholar Gateway, Owkin) via OAuth.

consensus.title: Consensus
consensus.description: Find answers in peer-reviewed research papers.

biorender.title: BioRender
biorender.description: Find scientific illustrations and icons in your BioRender account.

synapse.title: Synapse
synapse.description: Access datasets and projects in Sage Bionetworks' Synapse.

wiley.title: Wiley Scholar Gateway
wiley.description: Read journal content available to your Wiley account.

owkin.title: Owkin
owkin.description: Query Owkin's AI models for biomedical research.
owkin.unavailable: Owkin's sign-in does not support automatic client registration; it needs a client id issued to Tumbleweed.

plugins.name: nvidia-bionemo
plugins.description: Connect to hosted NVIDIA BioNeMo NIM endpoints (Boltz-2, OpenFold2/3, MSA Search, DiffDock, ProteinMPNN, RFdiffusion, GenMol, MolMIM, Evo 2) via Tumbleweed Bifrost Gateway with your own NVIDIA API key.

credentials.label: NVIDIA NIM API key
credentials.help: Create an nvapi-* key at build.nvidia.com; requests run on NVIDIA's third-party platform under your account.

nvidia-bionemo.title: NVIDIA BioNeMo NIM
nvidia-bionemo.description: Hosted BioNeMo structure prediction, protein design, docking, MSA search, and molecule generation (BYOK + per-task approval).

plugins.name: skills-scientific-writing
plugins.description: Citations & BibTeX verification, calibrated peer review, falsifiable hypothesis design, NSF/NIH/DOE/DARPA research grant writing, and scientific presentation decks.

plugins.name: skills-scientific-computing
plugins.description: Biopython sequence/structure analysis, Datamol molecular standardization, matchms MS/MS spectral similarity, and statistical hypothesis testing with multiple-testing correction.

plugins.name: bifrost-science-db-mcp
plugins.description: 10 additional scientific database MCP servers (Expression Atlas, Single Cell Expression Atlas, WikiPathways, BioSimulators, BioGRID, GtoPdb, SureChEMBL, PDBe, SIFTS, MyVariant) unified via Tumbleweed Bifrost AI Gateway.

credentials.label: BioGRID Access Key
credentials.help: Free registration access key required for BioGRID interaction queries.

credentials.label: GtoPdb API Key
credentials.help: Free registered GTP-API-Key required for IUPHAR/BPS Guide to PHARMACOLOGY queries.

bio-expression-atlas.title: Expression Atlas
bio-expression-atlas.description: Search EMBL-EBI bulk baseline and differential gene expression experiments.

bio-single-cell-atlas.title: Single Cell Expression Atlas
bio-single-cell-atlas.description: Explore single-cell RNA-seq studies and marker genes at EMBL-EBI.

bio-wikipathways.title: WikiPathways
bio-wikipathways.description: Search curated biological pathway models and cross-referenced genes/metabolites.

bio-biosimulators.title: BioSimulators & BioSimulations
bio-biosimulators.description: Discover standardized systems-biology simulation tools and COMBINE archives.

bio-biogrid.title: BioGRID
bio-biogrid.description: Query protein, genetic, and chemical interaction records in BioGRID (BYOK).

bio-gtopdb.title: Guide to PHARMACOLOGY
bio-gtopdb.description: Query IUPHAR/BPS pharmacological targets, ligands, and affinity interactions (BYOK).

bio-surechembl.title: SureChEMBL
bio-surechembl.description: Search patent chemical structures, patent bibliographic records, and Leadmine entities.

bio-pdbe.title: PDBe
bio-pdbe.description: Retrieve Protein Data Bank in Europe entry metadata, ligands, and quality validation scores.

bio-sifts.title: SIFTS
bio-sifts.description: Resolve residue-level PDB-to-UniProt, Pfam, InterPro, CATH, SCOP, and GO mappings.

bio-myvariant.title: MyVariant.info
bio-myvariant.description: Query aggregated human variant annotations across ClinVar, gnomAD, CADD, and dbNSFP.

plugins.name: tumbleweed-literature
plugins.description: Pre-installed scholarly literature source connectors for OpenAlex, arXiv, PubMed, Europe PMC, bioRxiv/medRxiv, Crossref, and Semantic Scholar, with optional API keys.

credentials.label: Semantic Scholar API key
credentials.help: Optional: unlocks dedicated Semantic Scholar API quota to avoid HTTP 429 rate limits.

credentials.label: OpenAlex API key
credentials.help: Optional: unlocks higher polite-pool daily rate limits on OpenAlex.

credentials.label: NCBI E-utilities API key
credentials.help: Optional: raises PubMed/NCBI E-utilities limit from 3 to 10 requests/s.

literature-openalex.title: OpenAlex (Literature)
literature-openalex.description: Broad cross-disciplinary scholarly works, citation counts, DOIs, and open-access links via built-in literature_search and literature_read. Optional OpenAlex API key raises daily quota.

literature-arxiv.title: arXiv (Literature)
literature-arxiv.description: Physics, CS, quantitative biology, and bioinformatics preprints and open-access PDFs via built-in literature_search and literature_read.

literature-pubmed.title: PubMed / NCBI (Literature)
literature-pubmed.description: Biomedical citations, abstracts, and PMC open-access links via built-in literature_search. Optional NCBI API key raises rate limit to 10 req/s.

literature-europepmc.title: Europe PMC (Literature)
literature-europepmc.description: Life sciences abstracts, citation counts, and open-access full-text PDFs via built-in literature_search.

literature-biorxiv.title: bioRxiv & medRxiv (Literature)
literature-biorxiv.description: Biology and clinical health sciences preprints and PDFs via built-in literature_search.

literature-crossref.title: Crossref (Literature)
literature-crossref.description: Authoritative DOI metadata, journal records, and publisher PDF links via built-in literature_search and literature_read.

literature-semantic-scholar.title: Semantic Scholar (Literature)
literature-semantic-scholar.description: Citation graph, abstracts, and open-access PDFs via built-in literature_search. Configure an optional Semantic Scholar API key to avoid HTTP 429 rate limits.

plugins.name: science-models
plugins.description: AI4Science model skills (need a GPU; listed as unavailable until one exists).

plugins.name: skills-tumbleweed
plugins.description: Two-Culture statistical & machine-learning modeling across computational biology/chemistry and clear, exact cross-disciplinary science explanation.
